title: `concepts/reasons-responsiveness` L50 and `topics/trilemma-of-selection` L74 still answer the rollback with "Why A rather than B? Because the agent had reasons for A", a contrastive claim that `topics/free-will` L94 and `apex/consciousness-and-agency` L115 retract ("the reasons for B were present in every replay too"); `concepts/quantum-indeterminacy-free-will` L126/L136 and `concepts/agent-causation` L101 carry it too
